title: A backtest can test the opposite of its stated hypothesis
limitations: The public fixture is synthetic and demonstrates semantics rather than market profitability
Its return magnitudes are intentionally separated so the direction error is visually obvious
The invalid historical run is not used as evidence for either direction
reopeningConditions: Feature window, target interval, execution interval, and direction all agree in a frozen contract
The corrected hypothesis is evaluated on an untouched sample
Invalid-run metrics remain quarantined from strategy evidence
